column3: “Make clear” is rendered “clear,” and “delighting” “delight”; “He” is capitalized for the messenger of the covenant.
“One who refines” is rendered “a smelter,” and “descendants” “sons”; NASB renders “they will be bringing near” as “they may present.”
“Hastening” is rendered “swift,” and “on” “against”; “defraud the hire of a hired laborer” is rendered “oppress the wage earner in his wages.”
“That” is rendered “For,” and “descendants” “sons”; NASB adds “therefore,” and renders “not come to an end” as “are not consumed.”
NASB renders “so let me return” as “and I will return.”
NASB adds “for”; “the nation all of it” is rendered “the whole nation of you.”
“House of the store” is rendered “storehouse,” and “until not sufficiency” “until it overflows.”
“Prove barren” is rendered “cast its grapes,” and “fruit” “fruits.”
“A land of delight” is rendered “a delightful land.”
“Have been strong on me” is rendered “have been arrogant against Me.”
“And therefore” is rendered “So now”; NASB adds “not only … but.”
“Paid attention” is rendered “gave attention,” and “document” “book”; NASB adds “it.”
“When I make a possession” is rendered “that I prepare My own possession,” and “have compassion” “spare.”
“You will return and see” is rendered “you will again distinguish.”
